limitations: This is the retained pre-interruption execution, not a new test run. The committed test/build/production files match the recorded LF source hashes.

Robolectric simulates Android API 33 on the host. Production MuPDFCore resolution, PageView hit testing, ReaderView tap dispatch/history, and fitz Java link classification/location conversion execute.
Native initialization and JNI document/link operations are substituted. A test PageAdapter supplies laid-out pages without rendering, and ReaderView tap/margin callbacks are observation spies.
No Android device, emulator, actual PDF parsing/rendering, DocumentActivity UI, or external application was exercised. The host setup is a synthetic three-page document, not a PDF fixture.
This is the focused LinkNavigationTest suite, not full application CI, Android instrumentation, or verification of an official released build.
